import numpy as np
from scipy import special

def cfmt(z):
    return float(np.real(z)), float(np.imag(z))

cases = [
    (-0.25, 0.5, 1+2j),
    (0.25, 0.5, 1+2j),
    (25, 1.5, -2j),
    (12, -1.5, -10+20j),
]

for i,(a,b,z) in enumerate(cases, start=1):
    val = special.hyp1f1(a,b,z)
    r, im = cfmt(val)
    # one scalar per recorded component so the harness can compare deterministically
    probe(f"hyp1f1_case{i}_re", r)
    probe(f"hyp1f1_case{i}_im", im)
